description: This file declares the MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend class, which provides an interface for querying supported key systems and their versions related to media key capabilities. It includes method declarations for singleton access, retrieving supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and obtaining their versions. The class holds a shared pointer to an external IMediaKeysCapabilities interface.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend
classes.description: A singleton class providing media key capabilities, including supported key systems and their versions.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system identifiers.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
